build.title: xLayout: Molly as one app (one banner, app menu, nav, context menu, toolbars) + IDE panes + plugin toolbars

said.text: Molly is whack. Create application menus, navigation menus, context menus, toolbars and a banner that integrate all the apps (AmberX, axHub web, Dev Console): only ONE banner, application menu, navigation menu and context menu render, covering the whole page; the user must not be able to tell it is multiple apps. New plugin xLayout renders it that way. A switch makes it IDE style: draggable, resizable, dockable panes. Plugin toolbars: from the plugin's settings, show/hide up to 3 toolbars and set each default location. A hook in those settings opens a Toolbar designer dialog: pick items from a list of every plugin and screen; each item opens in the main area or a floating window, or (IDE mode on) a pane. Right-clicking any toolbar also has a hook to open the Toolbar designer. IDE mode limits the number of panes and offers ~10 predetermined pane layouts with a preview before applying. Molly-only: standalone, each app stays exactly as it is. Replaces the queued 'Molly: one app' item. Rules: assets/tokens only, framework controls, settings level toolbar, plugin lifecycle, UI Review.

steps.text: xlayout@1 asset type (Fable): chrome-merge model, pane tree, pane limit, 10 layout presets as data, 3 toolbar slots (visible, location), toolbar items + open target (main|floating|pane); asset-types.json, validators, reference engine, fixture

Unified chrome engine (Fable): merge each app's app menu, nav, context menu, toolbars and banner widgets into one namespaced model; guests send chrome as data, host runs picks back (embed@1 takes, Molly host only)
Pane engine (Fable): dock/split/drag/resize tree, pane limit, apply a preset with content kept, open-in-pane routing
xLayout plugin scaffold in Molly: plugin.json, install/uninstall, Settings → Plugins → xLayout sub-tab (level toolbar), IDE mode switch
One banner + application menu + navigation menu + context menu across the whole page in Molly
Guests (AmberX, axHub web, Console) send menus/nav/context/toolbars as data under Molly and hide their own; standalone unchanged
IDE pane host: draggable, resizable, dockable panes; open-in-pane
Layout picker: 10 preset pane layouts, preview before apply, pane limit enforced
Plugin toolbars: up to 3 per plugin/screen, show/hide, default location, in the plugin's settings

Toolbar designer as its OWN plugin (toolbar-designer): own folder, plugin.json, install/uninstall, settings sub-tab; dialog lists every plugin + screen, open target main/floating/pane; hooks from xLay
Tests, check-theme/check-controls, help packs, lifecycle check
UI Review shots (desktop + phone), PR, THREADS
